content.title: Iran Plans To Drop Zeros From Its Inflation-Hit Currency As Bitcoin Hits Record Highs — Is Apex Crypto The Medicine Or Just A Fool's Gold?
content.summary: Iran approved a monetary overhaul Sunday to remove four zeros from the nation’s currency following years of high inflation.
